name: Gemini Code Assist Enterprise

price.note: Per user, monthly commitment. $45 per user per month on a 12-month commitment.

meters.label: Agent mode + Gemini CLI, daily
meters.hint: 2,000 requests per day; enter by hand

reset.rule: Resets at midnight Pacific time with other Google Cloud daily quotas.
stipulations: Agent mode in the IDE and Gemini CLI share this one daily pool.
One prompt can make several model requests.
At the limit, no model can be used through these tools until the reset.
There is also a limit of 120 requests per minute.

overage: No paid overage. Requests stop until the daily reset.

how: Up to 2,000 agent-mode and Gemini CLI requests per user per day, and 120 per minute.
Code completion and generation have a separate limit of 6,000 requests per day.
Gemini Code Assist on GitHub reviews at least 100 pull requests per day per installation.
ext: Gemini models only, and support is limited to the Gemini 3.x family.
Gemini CLI and the IDE extensions keep working with this license. The June 2026 cutoff applied only to consumer accounts.
quirks: No longer sold since 9 Oct 2026. Google recommends moving to Gemini Enterprise, which includes Antigravity.
Annual subscriptions can renew until 31 Jan 2027 and monthly ones until 31 Dec 2027. You can add licenses until 31 Jan 2027.
There is no usage readout for the daily limit, so enter readings by hand.

events.what: Last day to renew an annual subscription or add licenses.
